posts.text: The real moat is never the platform itself. It’s the time with large share of customers on that platform you have. That gives you extremely important data on behaviour, needs, demands, seasonality etc of the customers which any new player will take years recreating. That imo gives you that advantage to supply what is needed and not keep random assortment. That is the real moat. Another thing is relationships and knowledge base on supply side. posts.community: Vasa Denticity aka Dentalkart - The Indian Amazon of Dental supplies ?!
posts.text: Been looking at this business for a couple of weeks. It definitely looks interesting, but I have a few reservations: First, what exactly is the moat here? I think we can all agree that they have a first-mover advantage in selling these products online, and it is somewhat of a platform business. But in my view, the platform itself is becoming less of a moat. The barrier to building an online platform today is not very high, and anyone can replicate it. I think owning the supply chain or manufacturing is a much stronger moat in the current environment, which VASA does not have. Also, unlike Flip…
